summary: Full frontend sweep for dark theme feature (localStorage 'buildcore-theme'). Tested theme toggle on login page, persistence across login + full page reload, dark rendering on all admin pages (dashboard, projects list, project detail all 5 tabs, project finance, admin finance both tabs, payroll, users, procurement/vendors, project procurement), New Project modal, notification popover, sidebar toggle back to light, logout persistence, and dark rendering for Client (priya) + Vendor (vikram) + Site Engineer (raj) roles. Programmatically scanned every rendered element for near-white backgrounds (r,g,b > 240, alpha > 0.5, visible size) across all pages — zero unflipped light surfaces detected. Charts, gauge track, gantt bars, balance sheet tables and shadcn components all render with proper dark surfaces. Light-mode regression: toggled back to light on admin dashboard — full styling preserved from iteration_14 (screenshot confirms). All 100% pass.
